en.headline: LCSD dance bills by local choreographers go on sale 1 September
en.dek: Three new works by Kaki Lee, Ching Chu and Rosalie Ng will play in Kwai Tsing and Tai Po this autumn and winter under the Hong Kong Artists Series 2026.
body: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department said on Friday that its Hong Kong Artists Series 2026 will present three new dance works by local choreographers Kaki Lee, Ching Chu and Rosalie Ng. Tickets go on sale at URBTIX from 10 a.m. on 1 September.

Lee's After Silence: Echo plays at the Black Box Theatre of Kwai Tsing Theatre on 16 and 17 October at 8 p.m. and on 18 October at 3 p.m. Tickets are priced at 280 dollars. The Leisure and Cultural Services Department said the piece draws on Albert Camus's writing on the absurd and uses elastic bands as a central image, with two dancers in a cycle of tension and release.

A double bill of Ching Chu's How to Build a ______ and Rosalie Ng's Dear, will be staged at the Black Box Theatre of Tai Po Civic Centre on 18 and 19 December at 8 p.m. and on 19 and 20 December at 3 p.m. Tickets are priced at 250 dollars. The department said Chu's work looks at everyday tools and physical labour, while Ng's piece examines the aftermath of loss.

A 30 per cent early-bird discount on standard tickets runs from 1 to 14 September. Telephone bookings can be made on 3166 1288. Programme enquiries and concession details are available on 2268 7323, the department said.

zh.headline: 康文署香港藝術家系列三齣新舞作 9月1日開售
zh.dek: 李嘉禊、朱晴及伍家蔚新作將於今秋至冬季在葵青劇院及大埔文娛中心黑盒劇場上演，早鳥優惠至9月14日。
body: 康樂及文化事務署周五公布，「香港藝術家」系列2026將上演李嘉禊、朱晴及伍家蔚三齣本地編舞新作，門票由9月1日上午10時起於城市售票網發售。
李嘉禊作品《沉默之後：回聲》於10月16及17日晚上8時、10月18日下午3時在葵青劇院黑盒劇場演出，票價280元。康文署表示，作品取材卡繆有關荒謬的書寫，以橡筋為核心意象，兩名舞者在拉扯與釋放之間循環。
朱晴《如何建造______》與伍家蔚《親愛的，》將以雙作品形式，於12月18及19日晚上8時、12月19及20日下午3時在大埔文娛中心黑盒劇場演出，票價250元。署方指朱晴的作品從日常工具與體力勞動出發，伍家蔚的作品則處理失去之後的情緒餘波。
標準票於9月1日至14日設七折早鳥優惠。電話訂票可致電3166 1288，節目查詢及優惠詳情可致電2268 7323。
